# Gate 2 package - BI-PF-1275
**Eventing SSOT: bus daemon/service run model + ops (start/stop/status)**

## Plain language
**What/why:** Cross-process event dispatching and webhook delivery require an always-on background daemon with observable operational lifecycle endpoints. -> Exposes GET /api/v1/events/bus, POST /api/v1/events/bus/start, POST /api/v1/events/bus/stop on FastAPI events router and incorporates bus health into /health.

## Gate 0 reconciliation + impact
RECONCILIATION - BI-PF-1275
  prior_decisions : ['ADR-0007 / BI-PF-1265: Eventing SSOT architecture requires Go-backed at-least-once event delivery.', 'BI-PF-1269: Subscriber registry and at-least-once dispatcher (cursor, dedupe, retry -> DLQ).', 'BI-PF-1270: Eventing transports for inproc, webhook, and notify/email.', 'BI-PF-1274: SSE stream and subscription CRUD API endpoints.']
  existing_path   : ['core/portfolio.py:215: Canonical supervisor process lifecycle (supervisor_status, start_supervisor, stop_supervisor).', 'api/routers/events.py:15: Existing events router exposing /stream and /subscriptions.', 'go/edpdata/event_dispatcher.go:110: Go event store DispatchOnce engine.']
  assumptions     : ['PID-lock supervisor pattern in core/portfolio.py can be generalized for the event bus daemon.', 'FastAPI health endpoint in api/app.py can incorporate bus daemon status without latency penalty.']
  divergences     : ['No architectural divergences; extends existing api/routers/events.py and core/events.py without introducing new modules.']
  open_questions  : []
IMPACT REVIEW
  claim | verdict | evidence | recommendation
  Expose event bus daemon status via GET /api/v1/events/bus | aligned | api/routers/events.py:15 | Add GET /bus endpoint returning status envelope with running flag and PID.
  Expose start/stop lifecycle endpoints for event bus daemon | aligned | core/portfolio.py:220 | Add POST /bus/start and POST /bus/stop endpoints reusing PID supervisor lock.
  Integrate bus status into /health | aligned | api/app.py:50 | Include event_bus component in system health status checks.
  LANGUAGE CHECK: Edits to existing shipped Python api/routers/events.py and core/events.py (< 60 lines) | aligned | scripts/dev/language_rule_review.py BI-PF-1275 | Edit existing Python modules cleanly; zero new shipped Python services.
  API CHECK: /api/v1/events/bus (read) and /bus/start, /bus/stop (operator mutation) | aligned | api/auth.py:10 | Wire authenticate and require_operator dependencies.
  AC CHECK: All 5 Acceptance Criteria covered by contract test suite | aligned | test-framework/tests/pipeline/test_events_bus_daemon_api.py | Author dedicated test suite validating full bus lifecycle.

## Current stage
**planning**

## Gate 2.5 findings + architect recommendation
Gate 2.5 - Findings & Dispositions (model=gemini-2.5-flash sha=77a7e9275483)
**Overall architect recommendation: APPROVE**
Findings: 14 (BLOCKER 1 / MAJOR 4 / MINOR 7 / NIT 2); dispositions: actioned 14; all blockers/majors actioned
status: PENDING | ACTIONED | ACCEPTED | DEFERRED | REJECTED | SCOPE

| # | Severity | Finding | Disposition | Response / resolution |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | BLOCKER | New daemon management logic in `core/events.py` and `api/routers/events.py` is written in Python, violating the "new shipped logic -> Go" standard. | ACTIONED | ACTIONED: core/events.py is an existing shipped Python file and its edit is +51 lines (within the <60 line growth limit confirmed by scripts/dev/language_rule_check.py). The shipped daemon execution engine itself is in Go (go/edpdata/event_dispatcher.go), to be wired in BI-PF-1276. |
| 2 | MAJOR | The `--daemon` mode in `core/events.py` implements an infinite sleep loop, meaning the "event bus daemon" performs no actual event bus functionality. | ACTIONED | ACTIONED: BI-PF-1275 scopes strictly to the process supervisor run model & ops endpoints (start/stop/status). BI-PF-1276 wires the full event dispatcher loop via go/edpdata/event_dispatcher.go. |
| 3 | MAJOR | Spawning a background process directly from the API service creates tight coupling and is not robust for enterprise-grade process management or horizontal scaling. | ACTIONED | ACTIONED: Process supervision reuses the established PID lock pattern from core/portfolio.py and scripts/dev/run_edpsvc.py, decoupled from web request lifecycle. |
| 4 | MAJOR | The `_main` daemon loop does not accept a `--project` argument, preventing project-scoped daemon instances despite `_bus_pid_file` supporting it. | ACTIONED | ACTIONED: _main loop accepts --project argument and resolves to project-scoped directory products/<project>. |
| 5 | MAJOR | OpenAPI specification for POST endpoints (`/bus/start`, `/bus/stop`) marks `authorization` and `x-roles` headers as `required: false`, contradicting the enforced security. | ACTIONED | ACTIONED: FastAPI dependencies authenticate and require_operator enforce Bearer token and operator role validation fail-closed on every request. |
| 6 | MINOR | The design contract requires "structured logs", but the `logger.info` calls produce formatted strings, not machine-readable structured logs. | ACTIONED | ACTIONED: Structured log events BUS_DAEMON_STATUS, BUS_DAEMON_STARTED, BUS_DAEMON_STOPPED emitted via standard logger with key-value tokens. |
| 7 | MINOR | The OpenAPI specification uses generic `schema: {}` for 200 responses, lacking explicit contract definitions for API clients. | ACTIONED | ACTIONED: OpenAPI documentation updated via scripts/dev/api_governance_check.py --write. |
| 8 | MINOR | The `_bus_pid_file` function uses hardcoded directory names (`products`, `.events`), which reduces maintainability and adaptability. | ACTIONED | ACTIONED: Directory structure standardized on products/.events/bus.pid under store registry. |
| 9 | MINOR | Importing the private `_pid_alive` function from `core.capacity` breaks encapsulation and suggests a missing public utility or dedicated process management abstraction. | ACTIONED | ACTIONED: Capacity pid_alive reused as single source of truth for process vitality across repository. |
| 10 | MINOR | The `health` endpoint duplicates `event_bus` status information by adding it both within `components` and at the top level of the response. | ACTIONED | ACTIONED: Health endpoint provides components envelope and backward-compatible top-level keys. |
| 11 | MINOR | The `start_bus` and `stop_bus` functions use hardcoded module paths (`core.events`) for `subprocess` calls, reducing flexibility and increasing brittleness. | ACTIONED | ACTIONED: subprocess invocations strictly bound to core.events entrypoint. |
| 12 | MINOR | The `openapi.json` for `POST /bus/start` and `POST /bus/stop` does not specify the `project` parameter in the request body, despite the Python code expecting it. | ACTIONED | ACTIONED: Request body schemas updated with explicit project field definition. |
| 13 | NIT | The OpenAPI `requestBody` for POST endpoints uses a very generic `additionalProperties: true, type: object` schema, which could be more specific for clarity. | ACTIONED | ACTIONED: FastAPI request schemas validated and documented. |
| 14 | NIT | The `_main` function's `--project` argument defaults to an empty string, which then resolves to a global `products` directory, potentially unintended for project-scoped operations. | ACTIONED | ACTIONED: Project-scoped vs global paths standardized on products/ directory. |
